repair_dag.statement: Use |psi_t Z_t| <= (3/2) eta c^2 under eta tau_C L <= 1/4.
Use conditional variance <= 4 eta^2 c^2 A_t and Freedman rho=3/32.
Absorb (1/4) eta sum A_t and retain 16 eta c^2 log(2/delta).
After division and normalization, retain 16 c^2 log(2/delta)/T.
Apply a simultaneous per-step sub-Weibull union bound, not the invalid unnormalized sum inequality.
With c^2 of order sigma^2 log(T/delta)^(2theta)+zeta^2, the Freedman remainder contributes a square-root rate with one additional log(1/delta) factor.
Inverting that residual for accuracy epsilon requires (sigma^2 log(1/delta)^(2theta+1)+zeta^2 log(1/delta))/epsilon^2, up to T/epsilon polylogs.
